content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Non-Payment
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you have failed to pay the rent due on June 1, 2024, as per the terms of the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Deadline
content_blocks.text: You are required to vacate the premises at 789 Oak Avenue, Forestville Borough, State of Novaria, by 5:00 PM on July 15, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.1_Penalties
content_blocks.text: If you fail to vacate the premises by the deadline, you will be subject to additional penalties as provided by law.
